headline: European and Latin American Airlines Cut Routes Over Rising Jet Fuel Costs
summary: Airlines in Europe and Latin America are trimming flight routes and seat capacity after aviation fuel prices surged over 80% year-on-year, driving projected ticket prices up by more than 20%.
why: Jet fuel represents one of the largest operating expenses for commercial passenger airlines globally.

impacts.name: Global Airline Industry
impacts.why: Elevated jet fuel costs compress carrier profit margins and force route reductions.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
